rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" autoreconf -vfi
if [ "`bh_os_bits $AELTRA_HOST_TYPE`" = "32" ]; then export TIME_T_32_BIT_OK=yes fi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_BUILD_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE"
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/uncompress" ln -sf gunzip "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/uncompress"
